_comment: Per-strategy disciplined-gate baseline. Each strategy's CI lower bound from the offline disciplined gate (promotion_panel 5 layers: 20y bootstrap + 10bp slippage + block bootstrap + period stability + multi-testing). Live monitoring compares the strategy's ROLLING live PF against this baseline. Source: project_2026_05_22_backtest_factory_findings.md. Update this file when the gate is re-run against fresh evidence.
generated_from: promotion_panel applied to 20y backtests + archived live trades

forge_xs_momentum.notes: Strongest config tested. Passes 8/8 layers including block bootstrap. Edge concentrates in moderate-high VIX (>=20) regimes per 5/23 audit.

forge_spy_trend_follower.notes: Passes 7/8 layers. H1 fails on n=5 sub-sample (sparsity, not regime). Role: defensive beta proxy not alpha. 0.614 correlation with xs_momentum.

forge_gld_pm_long.notes: Fails at 5bp slippage. 522 trades / 2y cadence → slippage drag destroys edge. Live evidence still useful for re-evaluation as n accumulates.

forge_nq_overnight.notes: Net loser at 3bp slippage. 713 trades / 2y. Don't promote to real money. Monitor live: if rolling PF >= 1.0 persistently, re-evaluate.

forge_pead.notes: CI lower 1.17 — literally 0.03 below 1.20 floor. Point PF looks great but n too small. Non-curated SPX-50 also fails (CI lower 1.07). Edge IS real, sample IS too small.
